module: Career tutorial imgui debug menu. It shows the current step, buttons to start/advance/end the tutorial, jump to a step, open the contract signing screen, simulate a damaged vehicle or leaving the zone, and manage the display of bounds zones. It also calls onDebugMenu(im) of the current step's extension if it has one.
notes: debugName is "Tutorial" and debugOrder 100: these fields are used by the debug menu system.
If career_modules_tutorial is not loaded, the menu only displays "Tutorial module not loaded".

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the imgui content of the tutorial debug menu (called every frame by the debug system).
